content.plain: Rational numbers represent ratios of integers with nonzero denominator.
content.exact: ℚ may be constructed from pairs (a,b)∈ℤ×(ℤ\{0}) modulo (a,b)~(c,d) iff ad=bc.
content.example: (1,2) and (2,4) represent the same rational number.
content.caveat: A written decimal need not be rational unless its expansion eventually repeats.
